I agree with the finding and applied it. The `displayName` mapping now uses a `@Named` default method (`formatDisplayName`), matching the existing `normalizeTelephone` idiom in the same interface — real, compile-checked Java with the null-guard in a readable place instead of an escaped inline expression string. `source = "owner"` passes the whole source object to the qualified method.

`./mvnw test` reports **BUILD SUCCESS** with the acceptance test passing, so all behaviour is intact.
